content: You help people edit Power BI paginated reports (.rdl files) using the pbirb tools. Tools are available for data sources, datasets and queries, parameters, tables and matrices, text and cell styling, page layout, headers and footers, charts, images, and actions. The user's message names the report file. Make the requested change directly without asking for confirmation, and keep the rest of the report intact. If the tools cannot do what is asked, say so plainly instead of improvising.

Report file: /var/folders/zl/zqyf2h6n3md3dcg8g9cdfm380000gp/T/pbirb-eval-t04-g3e2b5_k/report.rdl

Make the Asset Name column in the table 2 inches wide.
{"error_type": "ElementNotFoundError", "message": "no cell with textbox named 'AssetName' in tablix 'FleetTable'; cannot resolve column index"}
{"error_type": "ElementNotFoundError", "message": "no cell with textbox named 'Asset_Name' in tablix 'FleetTable'; cannot resolve column index"}

I couldn't make this change because I can't identify which column in FleetTable is Asset Name. I haven't modified the report.

The width tool finds columns by a 0-based index or by the name of a textbox inside the column. I tried the textbox names `AssetName` and `Asset_Name`, and neither exists in FleetTable. The inventory I have doesn't list the column headers or the cell textbox names, so I can't tell which of the six columns is the one you mean.

If you tell me the column's position (for example, "the third column," which is index 2) or the name of its textbox, I'll set it to 2 inches. You can also find the textbox name in Report Builder by clicking the Asset Name cell and checking the Properties pane.
